title: Application image and chart artifact relationship
expected: Build image and chart targets with an explicit dependency.
Bind the actual image digest in generated chart values; preserve original values.yaml.
Artifact-binding syntax remains a design decision; binding intent is fixture data outside the project.

cases.name: digest-mismatch
cases.change: Attempt publication with a different image digest.

limitations: Container assembly requires a Linux target binary supplied to the declared Docker context path. Artifact binding awaits Oyzu; no native combined pipeline is supplied.
Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
